serviceObjectives.objective: Completed files are byte-correct after Range transfer, fallback, or recovery.
serviceObjectives.target: zero silent corruption and zero false-completed outcomes
one through eight segments per download

serviceObjectives.objective: Queue progress uses one canonical calculation for completed bytes, speed, and ETA.
serviceObjectives.target: UI consumes download_engine::TransferMetrics without duplicating formulas

telemetry.cardinalityPolicy: Only enumerated states/errors and numeric measurements; no user-controlled labels.
telemetry.samplingPolicy: Queue snapshots are emitted on state/progress updates; resource profiling is test-only and is not persisted.

recoveryEvidence.expected: validated state restored after corrupt live record
byte-identical completed output and single-stream fallback

implementationNotes: Transfer metric business rules and the concurrency ceiling reside in the shared Rust engine and are consumed by the Tauri adapter.
No hosted service, production deployment, production credential, or destructive database action is part of this workstream.
Independent disposition remains owned by ENG-15.
knownRisks: The current engine buffers each segment response in memory before writing it, so peak memory remains proportional to the active payload and needs a streaming-write follow-up.
Runtime CPU, memory, disk, and UI-latency baselines have not been measured on a representative packaged Windows build.
Pause and cancel UI state currently do not interrupt the underlying transfer task; recovery evidence covers persisted manifests, not a complete control-plane implementation.
